deprecated_yaml.description:
Your existing HTTP configuration from `configuration.yaml` has been imported. The `http` integration is now configured from the UI under **Settings** > **System** > **Network**.

Please remove the `http:` block from your `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml.title: The HTTP YAML configuration is deprecated

deprecated_yaml_import_error.description: Migrating the `http` configuration from `configuration.yaml` to the integration's storage failed. Please check the logs for details and configure the `http` integration from the UI under **Settings** > **System** > **Network**.
deprecated_yaml_import_error.title: Failed to import HTTP YAML configuration

ssl_configured_without_configured_urls.description:
Home Assistant detected that SSL has been set up on your instance, however, no custom external internet URL has been set.

This may result in unexpected behavior. Text-to-speech may fail, and integrations may not be able to connect back to your instance correctly.

To address this issue, go to Settings > System > Network; under the "Home Assistant URL" section, configure your new "Internet" and "Local network" addresses that match your new SSL configuration.
ssl_configured_without_configured_urls.title: SSL is configured without an external URL or internal URL

abort.issue_ignored: The `{profile}` profile stays in use and this repair is ignored.
abort.pending_config: Another HTTP configuration change is waiting to be applied or confirmed. Confirm or revert it first, then try again.

confirm_intermediate_v6.description:
Home Assistant will restart and use the **Intermediate v6** profile. Very old clients that rely on the older encryption methods, for example Internet Explorer on Windows 7 or 8.1, will no longer be able to connect.

After the restart, confirm the new configuration within 5 minutes. If you don't, for example because you can no longer connect, Home Assistant restores the `{profile}` profile automatically.
confirm_intermediate_v6.title: [%key:component::http::issues::ssl_profile_outdated::title%]

confirm_modern_v6.description:
Home Assistant will restart and use the **Modern v6** profile. Devices and browsers without TLS 1.3 support will no longer be able to connect.

After the restart, confirm the new configuration within 5 minutes. If you don't, for example because you can no longer connect, Home Assistant restores the `{profile}` profile automatically.
confirm_modern_v6.title: [%key:component::http::issues::ssl_profile_outdated::title%]

ignore.description: Home Assistant keeps using the `{profile}` profile and this repair will be hidden. You can change the profile at any time under **Settings** > **System** > **Network** > **HTTP server** > **SSL/TLS**.
ignore.title: [%key:component::http::issues::ssl_profile_outdated::title%]

init.description:
Your Home Assistant's HTTPS encryption settings are outdated. They use `{profile}`, the previous default SSL profile, which is based on Mozilla's TLS recommendations from 2016 (version 4) and still allows older encryption methods that are no longer considered secure. Your SSL certificate is not affected and does not need to change.

We recommend upgrading to **Modern v6**, based on the current recommendations (version 6). It only accepts TLS 1.3, which all browsers, the Home Assistant apps, and operating systems released since 2018–2019 support.

If older devices that no longer receive updates, such as smart TVs, cameras, or hubs, connect to Home Assistant directly, choose **Intermediate v6** instead. It also accepts TLS 1.2, but only with current encryption methods.

Oldest supported clients:

| Profile | Chrome | Firefox | Safari | iOS | Android | Edge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Modern v6 | 70 | 63 | 12.1 | 12.2 | 10 | 75 |
| Intermediate v6 | 49 | 31 | 9 | 9 | 4.4 | 15 |

The upgrade is safe to try: if you don't confirm the new profile within 5 minutes after the restart, Home Assistant switches back to `{profile}` automatically. You can close this dialog to decide later, or change the profile at any time under **Settings** > **System** > **Network** > **HTTP server** > **SSL/TLS**.

menu_options.confirm_intermediate_v6: Upgrade to Intermediate v6 (for older devices)

init.title: [%key:component::http::issues::ssl_profile_outdated::title%]

yaml_still_present_after_migration.description: The HTTP configuration in `configuration.yaml` has already been migrated and is now being ignored. Please remove the `http:` block from your `configuration.yaml`. Manage the HTTP configuration from the UI under **Settings** > **System** > **Network**.
yaml_still_present_after_migration.title: HTTP YAML configuration is ignored after migration
